scope: Build ordinary and independently reviewed direct-proof WIT/WASI packages twice; retain receipt-closed offline archives; prove the component interface exposes one UInt32 payload and no proof slot; execute and relocate the installed Wasmtime host; and require the real component boundary to reject three attempted arguments while leaving output unchanged.

edits.current:
- name: Qualify direct proof erasure in the prepared WIT package
        id: direct_proof_wit
        continue-on-error: true
        timeout-minutes: 100
        run: |
          export LEAN_BRIDGE_WASMTIME_C_API="$PWD/build/wasmtime-c-api"
          source scripts/env.sh
          bash scripts/run-direct-proof-erasure-wit-ci.sh
      - name: Preserve direct proof-erasure WIT acceptance
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: direct-proof-erasure-wit-${{ github.sha }}
          path: build/direct-proof-erasure-wit-ci/
          if-no-files-found: error
          overwrite: true
          retention-days: 30
